config.diagnosis_source: The diagnosis is the text the writer was given for the same question: the simulated photo diagnosis of E7 (sprout.experiments.e7_rag.simulate_identification, which names the plant's class that the question mentions, never the gold label) written by answer.diagnosis_summary. With no such class it says no photo diagnosis is available, plus the plant when the question states or names one. rag_dev and rag_test questions have no photos and use the same rule.
config.device: none: no GPU or local model is used; Sonnet runs through the claude command
config.label_signature: Not held in this record: the person's sign-off on this split's labels is the row for the split in orchestration/label_signoff.json, which `claims check` reads. labels_reviewed is false here by design.
config.source_note: The saved rag_dev answers this check was developed on (E7 run E7-20261104T040010301317Z) were written before T7.4 added the search with the diagnosed disease when the question finds nothing, so they do not reflect the retrieval served now; no saved set of served rag_dev answers with the fallback exists, and none was generated for this check. rag_test is answered with the fallback.
config.grader_prompt: question, diagnosis and answer; the reply is read strictly as FITS or WRONG

notes: Development check of the wrong-disease grader on the final served rag_dev answers. The prompt is frozen only after this. The wrong-disease check was not validated: no one read a sample of its calls on rag_dev, so how often it flags a good answer or passes a wrong one is not known. Its rate is a count of the grader's calls. the cheap check on rag_dev, per the person's direction; answers predate the fallback
